notes.title: I got one survey feedback! ^-^ Here are some fixes based on the feedback!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/443886daefc059298e8811210d1d09ea7f1c41ee.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a temporary fix to camera jankiness that lead to dizziness[/p][/*][*][p]Debugged NPC code to synch their animations with the Unity Jobs System code[/p][/*][*][p]Made some stairs have smooth climbing collision[/p][/*][*][p]Made some cutscenes better lit[/p][/*][*][p]Added some guidance for quest and dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]Coded in more and easier dialogue controls[/p][/*][*][p]Made more custom text icons for the new dialogue controls[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]So about the feedback:[/p][p]I received one survey feedback! Yehey!!!!! I was so happy when I first found out about it (Tv T ) Thank you very much!!!! I'm very very sorry that it made you dizzy (T_ T ) I hope you're ok. I really really appreciate that you tried to play as much as you can despite the camera's jankiness. You don't know how much it means to me[/p][p][/p][p]One of the things mentioned in the feedback was camera jankiness that lead to dizziness while playing.[/p][p][/p][p]I have this game on itch too. A fellow indie dev and I playtested each other's game (I posted my silent review on YouTube. I debuted as a gaming YouTuber AHAHAHHAHAHA joke. It's silent though coz I forgot to enable the sound. Back to topic, ehem. I got the same response about the camera.[/p][p][/p][p]I thought about it and checked. The jittery was actually due to the camera colliding with things like walls, and then trying to move itself towards the player to prevent the player from seeing what's behind those walls.[/p][p][/p][p]I removed the collision for now to try and prevent anymore dizziness. Please pardon seeing what's behind the walls/floors for now! (>.< )
[/p][p]I hope no one becomes dizzy again![/p][p][/p][p]PS1 - about the review, thank you thank you thank you thank you again! (>v < ) !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

PS2 - I also fixed some other things that got mentioned in the feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]================================[/p][p][/p][p]Would love to know your feedback too! ^-^[/p]

notes.title: Unforeseen Resurrection Received $26,048 Grant from Screen Australia
notes.content:
This is an exciting news that I should've shared earlier, but I was so over the moon and got sucked into continuing the demo's development. The Unforeseen Resurrection - Otome Isekai RPG was selected to receive an Emerging Gamemakers Fund grant from Screen Australia!

I almost stopped a few months earlier coz I was losing hope and needed to look for a job, but then the grant came just in time! It was such an awesome experience receiving the news! I am very grateful.
( >v<)

notes.title: Free Demo is Out Now :D
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/f9c4d74d26f6a5654113f93d86aefd50c8874539.png[/img]
Hello everyone! I just released the first version of the demo. Hope you could try it x]

==========================

Updated the demo to version 0.1.1 today at 8:49 pm PST.
[list]
[*] Camera control: tried to make it snappier to reduce motion sickness (kinda like the controls in GTA Vice City).
[*] Fixed broken quest feature bug.
Added grass, clouds, water, and many more optimisation when changing the graphics quality in the settings.
[*] Fixed a bug where equipment couldn't be equipped if replaying the game right after a game over.
[*] Made the 2D animation cutscene only play once after booting the game.
[*] Added a button for joining Discord.
[*] Fixed bug when locking camera, it sometimes got unlocked when it shouldn't be.
[*] Fixed pause bug. Sometimes it gets unpaused when it shouldn't be.
[*] Added images next to the right side buttons to quickly show what keyboard shortcuts trigger them.
[*] Added guidance to say that a weapon is needed to be equipped before the player can attack.
[/list]

- I added a new customization (gender, hair, hair color, clothes) and inventory feature, then made it work with multiplayer. 
- I also made the test scene look a bit nicer.
- Optimized the scene so the framerate is not low.
- Made the NPCs look at the players
- Fixed the feature that made the player able to turn their head and upper body, so that a player can see where the other players are looking at.
- Fixed the hair and skin material color and texture
- Synchronized hair, hair color, and clothes swap
- Added some key press to control the x and y movement of the camera. Can now lock the x and/or the y axis so it don't always look chaotic when moving the mouse
- Made the weather change dynamically and synched the weather change on the network

Gender visual: 
- made a new playable male character on Blender
- both male and female characters can wear the same hair, clothes, etc. For example:
   - a skirt can be worn by males as well
   - male hair can be worn by females as well
